author: smcarus
title: Will leveraged funds be more long the yen four weeks after entries close?
summary: Give the probability that the CFTC leveraged-funds net position in yen futures, as a share of open interest, is higher in the first weekly report on or after the settle date than in the first report on or after the close date.
knownLimits: CFTC reports are dated Tuesday and published on Friday; a US government shutdown can delay them.
